text:
[issue by GMLionDove]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.8

### Mod Loader

Forge

### Describe the Issue

After extensive testing I found that when running only balm using forge 58.1 on prism 8.4 that flying around in creative and going to the nether caused popups saying chunks failed to be be saved.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
This is a Forge bug that should happen to any block entities with capabilities attached. Forge is accessing the level for serialization in `saveAdditional` (as opposed to using the `ValueOutput`), even though level is not guaranteed to be non-null in that method.

Balm only makes this problem visible because it's attaching capabilities to some Vanilla blocks.
